description: Everything needed to SSH into a Cube: host, port, the login USER, and any pinned host keys. Call this rather than guessing a username — it is `ubuntu` or `debian` on Cubes created from images that ship a default user, and `root` on older Cubes, so it cannot be derived from the image id. The returned user has passwordless sudo; `sudo su` reaches root.

cubeId.description: The Cube id to operate on.

spaceId.description: Krova Cloud Space id. Optional if KROVA_SPACE_ID is set as the server default.

name: get_cube_ssh
title: Get Cube SSH Info
